title: Nonvanishing locus of a homogeneous polynomial Proj section
statement: Let k be a field, d>0, f a homogeneous polynomial of degree d on P=Proj k[x_0,x_1] [def-sc-p1-standard]. For L=O_P(d) and the section f/1 [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], its nonvanishing locus [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] is exactly D_+(f).

proof.text: The variables generate the polynomial algebra (MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X_eq_top). Mathlib Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top' therefore covers polynomial Proj by D_+(X_i). At each point choose such a degree-one g; Proj.isInvertible_twist gives invertibility of O(d). This uses the concrete twist construction, not the bundled polynomial chart theorem.

Apply mem_nonvanishingLocus_iff_generatesAt to identify nonvanishing with local free generation. For the chosen g, homogeneity of g^d follows from SetLike.pow_mem_graded, and Proj.basicOpen_pow (d>0) places the point in D_+(g^d). The theorem Proj.isFreeGenerator_unitToTwist gives the basis induced by g^d on this open.

Proj.map_unitToTwist_eq_smul writes the restriction of the global f section as c times this basis, where c is Proj.awayToSection of Away.mk representing f/g^d. Compatibility of application to 1 with restriction identifies its basis with the local g^d section. The source generatesAt_iff_mem_basicOpen identifies local generation with membership in the scheme basic open of c.

Proj.mem_basicOpen_iff_isUnit_val identifies that membership with invertibility of the value of c in the full prime localization. ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.awayToSection_apply, Away.val_mk and IsLocalization.map_mk' compute this value as f/g^d. IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_mk'_iff says this is a unit precisely when f is outside the homogeneous prime. Proj.mem_basicOpen identifies this with membership in D_+(f). Set extensionality proves the stated equality; the same computation covers f=0.

lean.statement:
theorem proj_homogeneous_section_tensor_powers_locus (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hf : f ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d) :
    let L := Proj.twist (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) (0 + (d : ℤ))
    ((Proj.basicOpen (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f :
        (Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Opens) : Set _) =
        nonvanishingLocus L ((Proj.unitToTwist hf).app ⊤ (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ 1))
